`hpke-base.json` is the base-mode X25519/HKDF-SHA256/ChaCha20Poly1305 case (first two encryption records) from the HPKE crate 0.12.0's `test-vectors-5f503c5.json`, distributed with that crate. It is public known-answer test data, not a production identity or secret. Upstream: https://github.com/rozbb/rust-hpke. Used to check compatibility with established HPKE vectors rather than just testing our own round trips.
